message.text:
No per-user API rate-limiting middleware exists. Echo only registers Recover and CORS. Auth middleware is present, but it does not enforce rate limits.

The README recommends rate limiting as a future feature. It is not yet implemented.

r02.
There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware and no request limits to report.

Echo is wired with only `Recover` and CORS (`server/server.go:51-52`). Auth is handled by the gRPC-Gateway / Connect authorizer in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, not a rate limiter. A repo-wide search finds no API limiter, 429 handling, or per-user quota. The only “rate limit” mention is a suggested future email-send limiter in `internal/email/README.md`, which is not implemented or registered.
